body:
sam_sales: Quick heads-up — Orion Fintech wants a POC next week. They need temporary Dedicated headroom: +8 GPUs for heavy reranking and embeddings. Windows: Tue/Wed 09:00-12:00 UTC (3h each). No long-term commit.

lee_eng: Can do ephemeral headroom. Two clarifying items: exact UTC windows (got it) and should this be burst credits only or a short reservation?

sam_sales: Burst-only please. Procurement asked about cost delta and whether we can route to cheaper models during the spike.

lee_eng: We can apply a burst_quota of 8 gpus for the specified windows with a cooldown of 45m. We'll add a routing override to prefer the quantized variant (opt1-q4) for rerank traffic during the burst. Fallback to opt1-full and then hosted API.

taylor_sre: Security checklist: do we have their KMS info and public IP blocks? If they insist on KMS-backed keys for the POC, lead time is ~2 weeks. For ephemeral keys we only need control-plane allowlist.

sam_sales: KMS alias provided: alias/orion-poc-key. Public IP ranges: 44.139.10.0/24 and 3.120.77.0/24. They're OK with ephemeral API keys for the demo.

ana_ops: Small correction — I'm ana_ops :). I can spin up ephemeral pool and issue scoped key. Ops questions: billing code? cost hold? and who signs off promo credit?

billing-bot: Non-committed burst billing = list price + 25% uplift. Promo credit must be approved by Revenue Ops/Deals. If customer converts to reserved within 45 days, we can apply partial credit (upto uplift).

sam_sales: I'll request promo. Can we track this in a ticket?

ops-bot: Creating ticket... Ticket POC-5032 created. Metadata: ephemeral_burst=8; windows=[2024-08-06T09:00Z/2024-08-06T12:00Z,2024-08-07T09:00Z/2024-08-07T12:00Z]; cooldown=45m; billing_code=ORION-EPH; assignee=lee_eng.

lee_eng: Taking POC-5032. Plan: 1) allocate ephemeral headroom 2) attach pool to orion-poc project 3) create scoped API key and upload to ticket 4) apply routing rule to opt1-q4 during windows 5) add monitoring and alert to #pocs.

infra-bot: Note: If quantized model isn't warm, cold-starts may add latency. Recommend pre-warming the q4 variant 15m before window. I can schedule a warm-up job.

lee_eng: Good call. I'll schedule warm-up at 08:45 UTC for both days.

ana_ops: Using ephemeral key workflow. Example CLI to create scoped key: ```
redwoodctl keys create --project orion-poc --scopes=generate,embed --limit=120000 --expires=2024-09-15
```

sam_sales: Sent Revenue Ops request for $1500 credit, included ARR motion and customer alias.

billing-bot: Received promo request. Auto-check: customer classification=MidMarket. Escalate to revenue-ops for approval.

lee_eng: Pool config pushed. Scoped key created and uploaded to POC-5032 (secure). Routing override & warm-up scheduled. Monitoring hooks in console: dashboard POC-5032.

sam_sales: Awesome — I'll confirm times with Orion and send calendar invites. If traffic exceeds burst_quota, what's the behavior?

lee_eng: Excess traffic will failover to hosted API per routing policy. We'll surface errors in the ticket and alert sales.

ops-bot: POC-5032 updated: status=ready, eta=2h before first window, comment="awaiting revenue-ops promo approval; keys available".

infra-bot: Reminder: if they later request VPC peering or private deployment, lead time = 2-3 weeks and requires network diagrams + KMS role.

sam_sales: Noted. Thanks everyone :rocket:

lee_eng: Closing loop — will post post-mortem if we see any anomalies after demo.

ana_ops: If revenue-ops approves credit, please ping me so billing code can be updated on the ticket.
